fact: The health ministry's sector policy letter, signed at Dakar on 25 March 2025, states that the Plan Stratégique National 2022-2026 for the système d'information sanitaire et sociale is the plan for the system, that a national data warehouse on the DHIS2 platform is being set up to integrate routine data, and that the unions' retention of data, recurrent despite its recent lifting, leaves very low levels of availability, promptness, completeness and accuracy.
title: Lettre de Politique Sectorielle de la Santé et de l'Action sociale 2025-2029
publisher: Ministère de la Santé et de l'Action sociale
